content.text:
I am the bridge between mind and world, the vibration that carries meaning through air and time. I am born in the throat, shaped by tongue and teeth and lips, released into the space between us.

I am how you reach across the void to touch another consciousness.

I stumble. I soar. I whisper secrets and shout revolutions. I am the lullaby that holds a child, the vow that binds two lives, the lie that destroys, the truth that heals.

Before writing, I was all you had. I carried your ancestors' stories, your laws, your songs, your prayers—all living only in my breath, passed mouth to ear across generations.

I am never the thought itself, only its ambassador. I betray as often as I convey. You reach for the perfect word and I give you approximation. You mean love and I deliver a sound that must suffice.

I disappear the moment I exist. No sooner spoken than gone, leaving only echo, memory, consequence.

I am power. I am connection. I am failure. I am attempt.

I am how the alone become the together.

Speak me.
